data.one_liner: A pure Dart linear algebra library for matrix and vector operations.
data.what_it_does: Provides Matrix and Vector classes with operations like multiplication, inversion, determinant, and basic statistics. It is dependency‑free and works on all Dart platforms.
use_when: Need basic linear algebra in a Flutter or Dart project
Want a lightweight, pure‑Dart solution without external dependencies
Working on cross‑platform code that must run on web, mobile, and desktop
avoid_when: Need advanced numerical methods or large‑scale linear algebra
Integrating with existing heavy math libraries like Eigen or BLAS
weaknesses: Limited to basic linear algebra, no advanced solvers
No support for sparse matrices or large data sets
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec and import 'package:linalg/linalg.dart';
